target='((..(((((........(.((..((.(.....(....).((((((((.........((......((((.....))))......))...((..((.......(..(......)..)..((..((.....((....)).((((.....(((.....(..((.(...).))..).....))).((((...(.......(..(.((...)).)..).......)...))))........)))).....((((((...)))))).))..))...........))..)).........(..((((....))((((((.....(........).....))))))..))..)...))))))))........).))..)).).....(.......).)))))..)).'

    elif c==')':

pairset={}
for (i,j) in pairs:
    pairset[i]=j
    pairset[j]=i

unit_positions={

 (305,336):'AACAUCAGCCGCUCCCCCCUGACCUAGAUGUU',
 (378,386):'GCAAAAAC',
}
covered=set()
for (s,e),seq_ in unit_positions.items():
    for k in range(s,e+1):
        covered.add(k)

seq=['A']*N
for (s,e),u in unit_positions.items():
    for i,c in enumerate(u):
        seq[s+i]=c

# For each contiguous helix run, alternate G-C and C-G or use A-U to weaken alt folds.
# Group pairs into helix runs by following the stacking pattern.
# Simpler: for pair positions not covered, alternate GC/CG/AU based on helix depth.
# Compute helix depth (consecutive stacked pairs) for each pair position.
# Approach: build adjacency for stacking. Pair (i,j) stacks on (i+1,j-1) if both are pairs.
is_pair = [[False]*N for _ in range(N)]
for (i,j) in pairs:
    is_pair[i][j]=True
    is_pair[j][i]=True
# depth: number of pairs in the helix from outermost (i,j)
depth={}
for (i,j) in pairs:
    d=0
    a,b=i,j
    while is_pair[a][b]:
        d+=1
        a+=1; b-=1
        if a>=b: break
        if not is_pair[a][b]:

    depth[(i,j)]=d

# pair strengths: alternate so that long runs don't form uniform GC alt-pairs
# Use pattern by depth mod: 0->GC closing, 1->AU, 2->GC, 3->GU(wobble)... keep simple: 
# outer (closing) = G-C, inner alternates C-G / A-U
pat=['G','A','G','C']  # i-side; j-side = complement
for (i,j) in pairs:
    if i in covered and j in covered:
        continue
    d=depth[(i,j)]
    ci = pat[d % len(pat)]
    cj = {'G':'C','A':'U','C':'G','U':'A'}[ci]
    if i not in covered:
        seq[i]=ci
    if j not in covered:
        seq[j]=cj

result=''.join(seq)
assert len(result)==398, len(result)
